guitar.notes: Corrected: Kim Thayil is Soundgarden's guitarist; Chris Cornell was primarily vocalist (occasionally rhythm guitar) so listing him as co-equal guitarist overstates his role. Kim Thayil's Guild S-100 is reasonably well documented.

tone.target: heavy grunge crunch with dry nasal fuzz
tone.profile: heavy grunge crunch with dry nasal fuzz
tone.summary: A heavy signal chain utilizing Fuzz and Distortion to achieve a thick, nasal crunch, paired with an aggressive British amp model and a robust 4x12 cabinet simulation.

rig.name: Soundgarden - Burden In My Hand - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain noise and hum inherent in grunge tones.
Provides the core 'nasal fuzz' and thick sustain required for grunge crunch.

alternatives.reason: If a more aggressive, less fuzzy distortion is desired.

blocks.purpose: Adds secondary grit and low-mid grind to complement the fuzz without losing definition.
blocks.gap: The combination of Fuzz + Distortion is used to mimic stacked vintage dirt (Big Muff/Fuzz Face) while maintaining mid presence.

blocks.purpose: Slightly boosts the signal into the amp to maintain punch and sustain.
blocks.gap: A dedicated EQ boost would also work, but a simple Boost module is sufficient for general lift.

blocks.purpose: Simulates the Marshall/Plexi sound and provides necessary mid-focus for grunge.
blocks.gap: The UK 45 is chosen over UK 50 for its slightly more aggressive, punchy character suitable for heavy rock.

alternatives.reason: If a slightly rounder, less biting tone was preferred.

blocks.purpose: Provides the classic British rock cabinet sound and necessary punchy projection.
Fine-tune the tone by slightly boosting mids and rolling off excessive bass/treble for a dry, focused sound.
Included as a placeholder; kept inactive to avoid the 'chorus' avoidance rule and maintain dryness.

blocks.purpose: Provides minimal, natural room ambience without sounding like deep reverb.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and tonal focus by swapping the default IR for a more aggressive, mid-focused grunge cab.

proposals.reason: Enhance Marshall/Plexi character and low-mid grind for heavy grunge tone.
